name: Charred plate
intro: One hot pan, one protein, and whatever's charred beside it. Peppers, zucchini, a nectarine. August's ten-minute dinner.

variations.context: Leftover chop, sliced and warmed, charred nectarine on the side.
Seared halibut, jalapeño and lime over the top.
No meat. Charred vegetables around torn burrata, pepper sauce.

finish: Heat the pan until it smokes. Char the vegetables first in a single layer, without moving them, until they blacken in spots. Move them to the plate, then sear or warm the protein in the same pan.
